title: Overgrown Tunnels
description: Makes the glacite tunnels overgrown instead of frozen.
body:
# Overgrown Tunnels
[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1296157888343179264?color=8c03fc&label=Discord&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/FsRc2GUwZR)
Overgrown tunnels changes the cold and frosty appearance of the glacite tunnels into a overgrown environment. By for example replacing the snow with moss or the ice with amethyst. ## Installation Guide - Prerequisites: [Catharsis](https://modrinth.com/mod/catharsis)
